programme.title: Road absurdities
programme.desc: Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruchała will set off on a blue siren to the capital.They will present parking spaces blocking the exit from the private parking lot.They will also be concerned about the ban on stopping and parking in a place that cannot be reached.Later they will go to Bobiecko, where they will see a viaduct leading from field to field, located only 500 meters from another viaduct.In Książnice they will see a huge hole in the newly renovated road, and in Musuły a pointlessly located pedestrian crossing.In Łódź, they will take a walk along the sidewalk leading straight to the watercourse, and in Aleksandrów, they will be impressed by a sign allowing them to park on the road, even at a bend.Gentlemen will also be surprised by a bicycle path only twenty meters long in Rudnik Mały and surprisingly low sound-absorbing screens in Gliwice.

programme.title: Road absurdities
programme.desc: We will see speed bumps at a roundabout in Kołobrzeg, excessive U12c bollards in Warsaw, 10 centimeters of sidewalk and a ban on pedestrian traffic at a crossing in Opole Lubelskie, and remnants of an unrealized tram investment in Łódź.We will also examine an interesting case from Lublin, where at one of the intersections, if you want to go straight, you go right.In Łuków, Syrenka S201 will pass through a roundabout where you cannot make a U-turn, and in Kielce it will pass soundproof screens that are not very useful.The last stop is Koniecpol, where colorful lanterns illuminate not only the road, but also the ditches.
